decisions.reason: Identifies PID 42432 dsh web host as koffi.node loader; loaded native module locked until host exits causes EBUSY copyfile failure.
States browser refresh only affects SPA not the host, and gives ordered stop→verify exit→install→verify→restart procedure without killing unrelated node processes.
Explains unpinned bare request follows latest=0.1.1-rc.2 (alpha=0.1.2-alpha.5), replacing alpha.4 rather than preserving it.
Gives npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 plus TUI, verifies dsh --version equals alpha.5, and restarts the host.
Tells README authors to pin the exact tested core version and avoid silently following latest over an existing prerelease, across plugin-only and combined command forms.
